- UP/DOWN: Move the player along the vertical track on the left
- RIGHT: Extends a horizontal path from the player's current position to the right
- LEFT: Probably retracts the path
The vertical track has segments at specific positions. Looking at the original track:
- g (gray) blocks at rows 14-15, 20-21, 26-27, 32-33
- G (dark gray) blocks at rows 16-19, 22-25, 28-31, 34-35
- Player at rows 36-41
The colored targets are:
- R (red): rows 19-22
- b (blue): rows 25-28
- N (green): rows 31-34
So the player needs to move to the correct vertical position and then extend the path RIGHT to reach the colored blocks. The goal seems to be to connect the path to each colored block in the order shown in the bottom panel: M(pink), R(red), N(green), b(blue).
Wait, but M is the player itself. So the order to collect might be: R(red), N(green), b(blue).
Let me check the current state - player is at row 32. The green block N is at rows 31-34, which aligns with the player's current position. Let me try RIGHT to extend the path and see if it connects to the green block.
But wait, looking at the image more carefully, the player is now at a higher position on the track. Let me verify the exact position and try to connect to a target.
